name: waymakerlabs-claude-plugins
description: A collection of useful Claude Code plugins by WaymakerLabs

plugins.name: minimal-statusline
plugins.description: Minimal single-line statusline with Nord Aurora theme

plugins.name: wrap-up
plugins.description: Session wrap-up skill - Obsidian documentation + Git commit in one go. Auto-generate daily log and handoff docs, with a pre-commit verification gate

plugins.name: obsidian-documents
plugins.description: Save to Obsidian - Auto-save content to Obsidian vault as markdown when asked

plugins.name: claude-organizer
plugins.description: Organize CLAUDE.md into a modular, skill-based project structure with Progressive Disclosure

plugins.name: verify-skills
plugins.description: Self-maintaining code verification framework - auto-generate and run project-specific verify skills

plugins.name: minimal-statusline-zai
plugins.description: Minimal single-line statusline for z.ai API with Nord Aurora theme

plugins.name: plan-and-build
plugins.description: Structured workflow: Research → Plan → Annotation Cycle → Implementation

plugins.name: math-exam
plugins.description: 수학 시험지/문제지 PDF 생성 - 중1~고3 학력평가/수능 형식, 한컴 수식 → LaTeX 자동 변환

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear issue management, dev cycle automation, and planning workflows

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki intake + recall + classify integrated helper. /llm-wiki:capture (external URL/memo → 00. Inbox intake with security redaction + 4-stage dedupe) + /llm-wiki:search (read-only 4-layer recall) + /llm-wiki:classify (inbox auto-classification, dry-run/live). Designed for Telegram(openclaw) adapter + home-macmini schedule.

plugins.name: orca-codex-delegate
plugins.description: Tracked Orca Run/Task orchestration procedures for delegating review or implementation work to Codex — read-only crosscheck and write-enabled implementation delegation, worker profiles, known Orca CLI pitfalls, and finding-report format. Requires the Orca desktop app with orchestration enabled.

plugins.name: focused-analysis
plugins.description: Dual independent-track cross-verification for hard diagnostic questions — an Opus subagent and Orca/codex orchestration run in parallel on the same question, then Claude synthesizes agreement/disagreement into one final judgment. Triggered by '집중 분석해줘'/'상세 분석해줘'. Requires the orca-codex-delegate plugin.
